evidence.notes: Local constructors expose deterministic empty body/header defaults and response OK status without network transport.
Mass email setters populate the same local no-transport sendEmail result path as single email messages.
Blank PageReference instances expose stable local URL, parameter, and header maps without Visualforce rendering.
Fresh request/response objects remain assignable after prior lifecycle work without invoking Apex REST dispatch.

source.content: @isTest private class PlatformLocalShapeCleanupFixtureTest { @isTest static void shapes() { HttpRequest req = new HttpRequest(); System.assertEquals('', req.getEndpoint()); System.assertEquals('', req.getMethod()); System.assertEquals('', req.getBody()); System.assertEquals(0, req.getHeaderKeys().size()); System.assertEquals(false, req.getCompressed()); System.assertEquals(10000, req.getTimeout()); HttpResponse res = new HttpResponse(); System.assertEquals(200, res.getStatusCode()); System.assertEquals('OK', res.getStatus()); System.assertEquals('', res.getBody()); System.assertEquals(0, res.getHeaderKeys().size()); Messaging.MassEmailMessage mass = new Messaging.MassEmailMessage(); mass.setTargetObjectIds(new List<String>{'003000000000001', '003000000000002'}); mass.setWhatIds(new List<String>{'001000000000001'}); mass.setTemplateId('00X000000000001'); mass.setDescription('Trail mass email'); mass.setOptOutPolicy('FILTER'); mass.setSaveAsActivity(false); List<Messaging.SendEmailResult> results = Messaging.sendEmail(new List<Messaging.MassEmailMessage>{mass}); System.assertEquals(1, results.size()); System.assert(results.get(0).isSuccess()); PageReference page = new PageReference(); System.assertEquals('', page.getUrl()); System.assertEquals(0, page.getParameters().size()); System.assertEquals(0, page.getHeaders().size()); page.getParameters().put('id', '001B000001DVM9t'); page.getHeaders().put('Accept', 'text/html'); System.assertEquals('001B000001DVM9t', page.getParameters().get('id')); System.assertEquals('text/html', page.getHeaders().get('Accept')); RestContext.request = new RestRequest(); RestContext.request.addParameter('after', 'reset'); RestContext.response = new RestResponse(); RestContext.response.addHeader('X-Reset', 'yes'); System.assertEquals('reset', RestContext.request.getParameter('after')); System.assertEquals('yes', RestContext.response.getHeader('x-reset')); } }
